title: tuberaria plantaginea
intro: Tuberaria plantaginea, commonly known as the sea lavender or wild lavender, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties, making it useful in treating wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tuberaria plantaginea include anti-anxiety, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which can help alleviate symptoms of anxiety, muscle spasms, and respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
